احتفرا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَرَا (iḥtafarā) /iħ.ta.fa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اُحْتُفِرَا (uḥtufirā) /uħ.tu.fi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اِحْتَفِرَا (iḥtafirā) /iħ.ta.fi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
